propositions: caused_by auto-derivation (file-level git blame over impacted paths) produces wrong or absent attributions for unmet-obligation, carrier-commit, and omission defect shapes
the mechanism derives caused_by edges with no provenance marker distinguishing blame-derived from explicitly-supplied edges, making the metric's confidence uncomputable
population measurement found 88 closed bugs with caused_by edges: 43% agree with deriver output, 7% disagree, 50% abstain (mostly no-majority or unresolvable)
subsample accuracy against independently proven origins (8 bugs): deriver reproduced 0/8 correct attributions; where it spoke confidently it named the wrong origin (1/1 wrong-target)
the blame fallback already fails closed in hard cases (50% abstention overall, 7/8 on proven origins), so declines to attribute where it cannot get right answers
